          <table style="width:487pt;margin-top:4pt;border-collapse: collapse;border-top:0.75pt solid #999899; font-style:normal;font-weight:bold;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:15pt;">
            <tr style="white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;font-style:normal;font-weight:bold;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">
              <td style="border-bottom:1pt solid #000000; width:24pt;">
                <div style="white-space:nowrap; line-height:15pt;font-size:15pt;">
                  <span style="letter-spacing:0.75pt;">Q</span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt;border-bottom:1pt solid #000000; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt;border-bottom:1pt solid #000000; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="border-bottom:1pt solid #000000; width:457pt;">
                <div style="white-space:nowrap; line-height:12pt;">
                  <span style="letter-spacing:0.5pt;">What is the Voluntary Retail Voting Program?</span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt;border-bottom:1pt solid #000000; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>
            <tr style="line-height:16.9pt;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">
              <td style="padding:9.733pt 0pt 0.5pt 0pt; width:24pt;">
                <div style="white-space:normal;font-weight:bold;font-size:15pt;">
                  <span style="letter-spacing:0.75pt;">A</span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:9.733pt 0pt 0.5pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;">We have adopted a &#8220;Voluntary Retail Voting Program&#8221; to enhance retail shareholder participation and facilitate voting at shareholder meetings.</span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>
            <tr style="line-height:16.9pt;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">
              <td style="padding:0pt 0pt 0.5pt 0pt; width:24pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:2.483pt 0pt 3pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;">After you have cast your votes for this 2026 Annual Meeting through most electronic voting platforms (e.g., ProxyVote.com and Say by Robinhood), you will be given the opportunity to enroll in the Voluntary Retail Voting Program for future meetings. If you enroll, you will be giving Tesla a standing instruction to vote your shares at </span><span style=" text-decoration:underline #000000 solid;letter-spacing:0.6pt;">future meetings</span><span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;"> (not the 2026 Annual Meeting). You will continue to receive proxy materials for all future meetings and will still have the opportunity to vote at any future meeting. However, if you do not choose to vote at a future meeting, your shares will still be represented and will be voted in accordance with your standing instructions.</span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>
            <tr style="line-height:16.9pt;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">
              <td style="padding:0pt 0pt 0.5pt 0pt; width:24pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:3.983pt 0pt 0.5pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;">The Voluntary Retail Voting Program is a practical tool to empower retail voice and is available at no fee. This is all explained in more detail in the following paragraphs.</span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>
            <tr style="line-height:16.9pt;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">
              <td style="padding:0pt 0pt 0.5pt 0pt; width:24pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:3.983pt 0pt 3pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="white-space:normal; line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:0.5pt;">How does it work?</span><span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;"> &#8212; If you choose to enroll in the Voluntary Retail Voting Program, you are providing a standing instruction to Tesla to vote your eligible shares at all future meetings. As a result, your shares will be voted without any further action or steps by you until you opt out. </span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>
            <tr style="line-height:16.9pt;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">
              <td style="padding:0pt 0pt 0.5pt 0pt; width:24pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:3.983pt 0pt 3pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="white-space:normal; line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:0.5pt;">If I choose to enroll, what are my standing instruction choices?</span><span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;"> &#8212; You will have two choices. The first is to have your shares voted with the recommendations of Tesla&#8217;s Board of Directors on all matters. The second is to have your shares voted with the recommendations of Tesla&#8217;s Board of Directors on all matters </span><span style=" text-decoration:underline #000000 solid;letter-spacing:0.6pt;">except</span><span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;"> any contested director election or any acquisition, merger or divestiture transaction that, under applicable state law or stock exchange rules, requires approval of Tesla&#8217;s shareholders (each, a &#8220;Special Matter&#8221;). You also will have the choice to opt out of the Voluntary Retail Voting Program. If you enroll, you will remain in the Voluntary Retail Voting Program until you opt-out. </span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>
            <tr style="line-height:16.9pt;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">
              <td style="padding:0pt 0pt 0.5pt 0pt; width:24pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:3.983pt 0pt 3pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="white-space:normal; line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:0.5pt;">Will I still be able to vote at future meetings?</span><span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;"> &#8212; Yes. Whether or not you enroll, you will continue to receive all proxy materials filed and distributed to shareholders for each shareholder meeting, free of charge, which will outline all proposals and the recommendations of Tesla&#8217;s Board of Directors. You can then decide to vote using those proxy materials, which will override your standing instruction. The most recent vote you submit before the closing of polls will take precedence. </span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>
            <tr style="line-height:16.9pt;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">
              <td style="padding:0pt 0pt 0.5pt 0pt; width:24pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:3.983pt 0pt 3pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="white-space:normal; line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:0.5pt;">How can I change or cancel my standing instruction?</span><span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;"> &#8212; You will receive a reminder at least once a year that you have enrolled in the program. This reminder will inform you of the standing instruction you have selected and remind you of your ability to (1) override the standing instruction for any vote by voting using the proxy materials and (2) change or cancel your standing instruction, at any time and at no cost, for future meetings. You can opt out of the program at any time and at no cost by following the instructions in the reminder, which will cancel the standing instruction for future meetings.</span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>

              <td style="padding:6.233pt 0pt 3pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="white-space:normal; line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:0.5pt;">Nominees for inclusion in Tesla&#8217;s proxy materials pursuant to proxy access &#8212;</span><span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;">Our bylaws also provide for a right of proxy access for annual meetings of shareholders. This enables shareholders, under specified conditions, to include their nominees for election as directors in our proxy statement. Under our bylaws, a shareholder (or group of up to 20 shareholders) who has continuously owned at least 3% of the outstanding shares of our common stock for at least three consecutive years and has complied with the other requirements in our bylaws may nominate up to 20% of the Board and have such nominee(s) included in our proxy statement. To be timely, notice of nominees should be delivered to Tesla, Inc., 1 Tesla Road, Austin, Texas 78725, Attention: Legal Department, with a copy sent by e-mail to shareholdermail@tesla.com, not less than 120&#160;days nor more than 150&#160;days prior to the one-year anniversary of the date on which Tesla distributed its proxy materials to shareholders for the previous year&#8217;s annual meeting of shareholders. As a result, notice of nominees for a 2027 Annual Meeting must be delivered to the address above not later than June 21, 2027 and not earlier than May 22, 2027. </span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>
            <tr style="line-height:16.9pt;min-height:54.69pt;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">

              <td style="padding:3.983pt 0pt 3pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="white-space:normal; line-height:11.9pt;font-weight:bold;">
                  <span style="letter-spacing:0.5pt;">Proposals and nominees to be brought at an annual meeting pursuant to our bylaws &#8212;</span><span style="font-weight:normal;letter-spacing:0.6pt;"> In addition, you can find in Tesla&#8217;s bylaws an advance notice procedure for shareholders who wish to present certain matters, including nominations for the election of directors, at an annual meeting of shareholders without inclusion in Tesla&#8217;s proxy materials.</span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>
            <tr style="line-height:16.9pt;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">

              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:3.983pt 0pt 3pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;">In general, Tesla&#8217;s bylaws provide that the Board will determine the business to be conducted at an annual meeting, including nominations for the election of directors, as specified in the Board&#8217;s notice of meeting or as properly brought at the meeting by the Board. However, a shareholder may also present at an annual meeting any business, including nominations for the election of directors, specified in a written notice properly delivered within the Notice Period (as defined below), if the shareholder is a shareholder of record at the time of the notice and the record date for the meeting. Such notice should be delivered to Tesla, Inc., 1&#160;Tesla Road, Austin, Texas 78725, Attention: Legal Department&#8201;&#8212;&#8201;Shareholder Mail, with a copy sent by e-mail to shareholdermail@tesla.com. The notice must contain specified information about the proposed business or nominees and about the shareholder giving notice. If a shareholder who has delivered such a notice does not appear to present his or her proposal at the meeting, Tesla will not be required to present the proposal for a vote. </span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
            </tr>
            <tr style="line-height:16.9pt;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;font-variant:normal;text-transform:none;color:#000000;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt 0pt 0.5pt 0pt; width:24pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:3pt;">&#8203;</td>
              <td style="padding:3.983pt 0pt 3pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;">The &#8220;Notice Period&#8221; is the period not less than 45&#160;days nor more than 75&#160;days prior to the one-year anniversary of the date on which Tesla first mailed its proxy materials or a notice of availability of proxy materials (whichever is earlier) to shareholders for the previous year&#8217;s annual meeting of shareholders. As a result, the Notice Period for a 2027 Annual Meeting will start on August 5, 2027 and end on September 4, 2027. However, if the date of a 2027 Annual Meeting is advanced by more than 30&#160;days prior to or delayed by more than 60&#160;days after the one-year anniversary of the date of the 2026 Annual Meeting, the Notice Period will instead start 120&#160;days prior to a 2027 Annual Meeting and end on the later of (i)&#160;90&#160;days prior to such meeting or (ii)&#160;the 10th day following our first public announcement of the date of a 2027 Annual Meeting. </span>
                </div>
              </td>
              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>

              <td style="padding:0pt; width:0pt;">&#8203;</td>

              <td style="padding:3.983pt 0pt 3pt 0pt; width:457pt;white-space:normal;">
                <div style="line-height:11.9pt;">
                  <span style="letter-spacing:0.6pt;">In addition to and without limiting or superseding the requirements under Tesla&#8217;s bylaws, shareholders who intend to solicit proxies in support of director nominees other than our nominees must provide notice that sets forth the information required by Rule 14a-19 of the Exchange Act no later than October 4, 2027, unless the date of a 2027 Annual Meeting has changed by more than 30 days from the previous year, in which case the notice must be provided by the later of 60 calendar days prior to the date of a 2027 Annual Meeting or the 10th calendar day following the day on which public announcement of the date of a 2027 Annual Meeting is first made.</span>
